# goslop text fixture (.txt) — materialized to .py at test/runtime
lang: python
file: CWE-1286-safe.py
---
import json
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import requests
from flask import request


def fetch_remote_document():
    target = json.loads(request.data)["url"]
    parsed = urlparse(target)
    if parsed.scheme != "https" or parsed.hostname != "api.example.test":
        raise ValueError("unapproved URL")
    return requests.get(target)
